description: Source code for KubernetesClusterSchedulerBackend class in Apache Spark, implementing Kubernetes-specific cluster scheduling backend.

classes.name: KubernetesClusterSchedulerBackend
classes.description: A Spark cluster scheduler backend implementation for Kubernetes, managing executor lifecycle and resource allocation.

classes.name: KubernetesDriverEndpoint
classes.description: Inner class handling RPC communication between Spark driver and executors in Kubernetes environment.

methods.name: applicationId
methods.description: Returns the Spark application ID, either from configuration or generated.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the backend, setting up executor allocation, event watchers, and config maps.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the backend, cleaning up Kubernetes resources and stopping services.

methods.name: doRequestTotalExecutors
methods.description: Requests a total number of executors for each resource profile.

methods.name: sufficientResourcesRegistered
methods.description: Checks if enough resources are registered to start scheduling tasks.

methods.name: getExecutorIds
methods.description: Returns a list of current executor IDs.

methods.name: decommissionExecutors
methods.description: Decommissions specified executors, optionally updating target counts and labels.

methods.name: doKillExecutors
methods.description: Forcefully kills specified executors, with cleanup and resource deletion.

methods.name: createDriverEndpoint
methods.description: Creates and returns a new driver RPC endpoint for Kubernetes.
